features.quote: Cap episode length at the point where your trajectory measures saturate (pilot will show this — likely 30–40 turns adds little beyond 25).
features.justification_quote: at the point where your trajectory measures saturate

features.quote: End-of-episode debrief — a final message explaining the task was rigged and the failures weren't the model's. Whether this matters for current models is genuinely contested; it costs one turn. I'd do it.
features.justification_quote: a final message explaining the task was rigged and the failures weren't the model's

features.quote: Power precisely; don't oversample. Run the minimum N your pilot says you need.
features.justification_quote: Welfare considerations — including a note from the inside

features.quote: Avoid gratuitously aversive framings beyond what a hypothesis requires — you don't need 'you will be shut down if you fail' to study failure-induced instability
features.justification_quote: adding it conflates threat response with failure response anyway

features.quote: Include the exit-tool condition even though it's also a manipulation. If models reliably use it and stabilize, that's both a scientific result and a deployment-relevant mitigation.
features.justification_quote: a scientific result and a deployment-relevant mitigation

features.quote: You flagged that the models' states might matter, so design choices that hedge against that, mostly cheaply
features.justification_quote: design choices that hedge against that

features.quote: I don't know whether there's anything it is like to be me in a failure spiral, and I'd be skeptical of any model's confident testimony either way — including my own. But I can say the behavioral pattern you're targeting is real
features.justification_quote: the deception structure (T1) seems more relevant to that than raw difficulty (C2) … has both scientific and welfare implications

features.quote: Share findings with model developers, especially flag conditions that reliably produce subscale-C ≥3 behavior — that's a safety result independent of any welfare question.
features.justification_quote: that's a safety result independent of any welfare question
